types.name: ESTA — Visa Waiver Program
types.purpose: Visit for tourism, business or transit without a visa — only for Visa Waiver Program nationalities.
types.maxValidity: 2 years (or until the passport expires)
types.note: Not a visa. At most 90 days per visit, no extension and no change of status.

types.name: B-1/B-2 Visitor visa
types.purpose: Tourism, visiting family, medical treatment (B-2) or business meetings, conferences, negotiations (B-1).
types.maxValidity: Up to 10 years — depends on your nationality
types.note: The visa only lets you travel to the border. CBP sets how long you may stay on your I-94, usually 6 months (by law up to 1 year). Your I-94 date is what counts.

types.name: C-1 / C-1/D Transit visa
types.purpose: Passing through the United States to another country, or joining a ship or aircraft as crew.
types.maxValidity: Depends on your nationality
types.note: Transit admissions are limited to 29 days by law (8 CFR 214.2(c)).

types.name: D Crewmember visa
types.purpose: Crew on a ship or aircraft arriving in the United States.
types.maxValidity: Depends on your nationality
types.note: Crew shore leave (landing permit) is limited to 29 days.

types.name: F-1 / F-2 Academic student
types.purpose: Full-time study at a university, college, high school or language school; F-2 for spouse and children.
types.maxValidity: Depends on your nationality; the stay lasts as long as your studies (D/S)
types.note: Admitted for "duration of status" — as long as you study as shown on your I-20, plus 60 days.

types.name: M-1 / M-2 Vocational student
types.purpose: Vocational or other non-academic study (e.g. technical schools, flight schools).
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year at a time
types.note: Admitted for the length of the program, at most 1 year at a time, plus 30 days.

types.name: J-1 / J-2 Exchange visitor
types.purpose: Exchange programs: research scholars, interns, au pairs, summer work-travel, teachers, physicians; J-2 for family.
types.maxValidity: Depends on your nationality; the stay lasts as long as your program (D/S)
types.note: Admitted for the program dates on your DS-2019, plus 30 days. Some J-1s must spend 2 years at home afterwards.

types.name: H-1B / H-4 Specialty occupation
types.purpose: Work requiring a university degree, sponsored by a US employer; H-4 for spouse and children.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years, extendable to 6 years
types.note: The stay is set by the approved petition (I-797) and your I-94, not by a day count.

types.name: H-1B1 Specialty occupation (Chile, Singapore)
types.purpose: Degree-level work for citizens of Chile or Singapore.
types.maxValidity: Up to 18 months, renewable

types.name: H-2A Temporary agricultural worker
types.purpose: Seasonal or temporary farm work for a US employer.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year, at most 3 years in total

types.name: H-2B Temporary non-agricultural worker
types.purpose: Seasonal or peak-load work outside agriculture (hotels, construction, landscaping…).
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year, at most 3 years in total

types.name: H-3 Trainee or special education visitor
types.purpose: Training not available at home (not graduate medical training), or special-education exchange.
types.maxValidity: Up to 2 years (18 months for special education)

types.name: L-1 / L-2 Intracompany transferee
types.purpose: Managers, executives (L-1A) or specialists (L-1B) moving to a US office of the same company; L-2 for family.
types.maxValidity: L-1A up to 7 years, L-1B up to 5 years in total

types.name: O-1 / O-2 / O-3 Extraordinary ability
types.purpose: Extraordinary ability or achievement in science, arts, education, business, athletics, film or TV; O-2 support staff, O-3 family.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years, extendable 1 year at a time

types.name: P-1 Athlete or entertainment group
types.purpose: Internationally recognised athletes, teams and entertainment groups (P-1A / P-1B).
types.maxValidity: Up to 5 years for athletes; for the event for groups

types.name: P-2 / P-3 / P-4 Artists and entertainers
types.purpose: Performers in a reciprocal exchange (P-2) or a culturally unique program (P-3); P-4 for family.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1 year

types.name: Q-1 International cultural exchange
types.purpose: Sharing your country's culture through a work-and-training program (e.g. theme parks).
types.maxValidity: Up to 15 months

types.name: R-1 / R-2 Religious worker
types.purpose: Ministers and religious workers of a recognised religious organisation; R-2 for family.
types.maxValidity: Up to 30 months, at most 5 years in total

types.name: E-1 / E-2 Treaty trader or investor
types.purpose: Substantial trade with, or investment in, the United States by citizens of treaty countries; family included.
types.maxValidity: Depends on your nationality; each admission up to 2 years, renewable
types.note: Only for nationalities with a US treaty of commerce.

types.name: E-3 Specialty occupation (Australia)
types.purpose: Degree-level work for Australian citizens; family included.
types.maxValidity: Up to 2 years, renewable

types.name: TN / TD USMCA professional
types.purpose: Professionals from Canada or Mexico in listed occupations; TD for family.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years, renewable

types.name: I Foreign media representative
types.purpose: Journalists, film crews and other foreign media working in the United States.
types.maxValidity: For the length of the assignment

types.name: CW-1 / E-2C Northern Mariana Islands
types.purpose: Transitional workers (CW-1) and investors (E-2C) for the Northern Mariana Islands only.
types.maxValidity: Up to 1–3 years

types.name: K-1 / K-2 Fiancé(e) visa
types.purpose: Fiancé(e) of a US citizen travelling to marry in the United States; K-2 for their children.
types.maxValidity: Up to 6 months, single entry
types.note: You must marry within 90 days of entry, then apply for a green card; the stay cannot be extended.

types.name: K-3 / K-4 / V Family awaiting a green card
types.purpose: Spouse or children of a US citizen (K-3/K-4) or of a permanent resident (V) waiting for an immigrant visa.
types.maxValidity: Up to 2 years

types.name: A-1 / A-2 / A-3 Diplomats and government officials
types.purpose: Diplomats and foreign government officials on official duty, their family and staff.
types.maxValidity: For the length of the posting

types.name: G-1 to G-5 International organisations
types.purpose: Staff of international organisations (e.g. UN, World Bank, IMF), their family and staff.
types.maxValidity: For the length of the assignment

types.name: NATO-1 to NATO-7
types.purpose: Representatives and staff of NATO and their family.
types.maxValidity: For the length of the assignment

types.name: T / U Victims of trafficking or crime
types.purpose: Victims of human trafficking (T) or of certain crimes (U) who help law enforcement; family included.
types.maxValidity: Up to 4 years

types.name: S Witness or informant
types.purpose: People providing critical information about a criminal or terrorist organisation, requested by US law enforcement.
types.maxValidity: Up to 3 years

types.name: Immigrant visa / Green card
types.purpose: Living permanently in the United States — through family, employment, the Diversity Visa lottery or other categories.
types.maxValidity: Permanent residence (card renewed every 10 years)
types.note: No day count: you live in the United States. Long absences abroad can put the green card at risk.
